The '''Muzara system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Evil Arisen}}
The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] came under threat c. [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] when a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] tried to recover a [[Unidentified Sith artifact|Sith artifact]] from [[Unidentified Muzara ruins|ruins]] on Muzara and bring evil to the system. A group of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] stopped the Sith followers before they could do so.<ref name="EA">{{WEGCite|story=Evil Arisen|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}
